protocol.stop_rule: Stop at first work/counter/span/I/O/operation/resource failure; retain partial prefix. Always stop by five, independent of descriptive null usability.

attribution.format: cairn-observer-ledger-2; CAIRNOB2; 40-byte header, 192-byte records; v1 readers reject
attribution.thread_identity: Main is the shared boundary OS thread. Terrain lanes bind actual VoxelEngine general-pool thread-entry incarnation plus OS TID and index 0; real exit retires identity. Persistent workers have drained detach, never a fictitious pool join. Writer lanes keep their joined lifetime proof.
attribution.raw_reads: Four current-thread stamps per span: begin API entry/exit, end API entry/exit. Each retains success/availability/error and enclosing wall bracket. Binary null payload is explicitly flagged, never a measured zero.
attribution.ownership: Full=end_exit-begin_entry; body=end_entry-begin_exit; bookkeeping=full-body. Exclusive body subtracts direct children full spans once, on the same lane. Root/child costs are never double-added to process demand.
attribution.section: 0 preparation, 1 +X, 2 -X, 3 +Z, 4 lifecycle tail; worker records retain start/end and submission sections. Crossing workers are separate, never assigned wholly to one section.
attribution.emission: Start precedes allocation/publication. Existing native and writer drains, writer detach, unpublish with zero in-flight scopes, copy immutable ownership/counts, destroy session, seal/emit/flush/close, explicit last-owner recorder disposal, hash, final shared boundary. Failed prefixes and raw errors remain; missing lifetime proof invalidates attribution.
attribution.unattributed: Ledger/session setup, dispatch/return outside stamps, uncaptured pool work, task scheduling, whole-engine/frame/renderer/driver work and allocator/OS retention remain unavailable. Direct scopes perturb scheduling. No thread/process addition or subtraction, correction, normalization or cycle/time conversion.
attribution.cadence: Native witness 4320 spans; tick output 4320 unit-bearing spans plus 3 zero-unit pose handover spans. Callback output/queries/frontier each once per gameplay/acknowledgement callback. Preparation queries once per loading callback. Four intermediate boundary snapshots. Writer lifetimes include file close before exit; queue writes distinguish qualification and proxy work.
attribution.byte_counts: The raw byte field is reserved zero for main/flush/lifetime scopes, reported as unavailable rather than measured zero. Writer qualification/proxy scopes retain actual UTF-8 payload bytes; whole-trial raw files and existing pose/cycle counts retain main output sizes.
attribution.native_admission: Only section 0 admits slots 13–16. Every admitted scope completes on actual return; retain end section and crossing demand separately, without clipping.
attribution.native_outcomes: units=1 is an attempt; complete=1 is actual RAII completion; bytes is an outcome tag, 1 normal or 2 meshing overload, not an output byte measurement. Original native counters remain separate.

bounds.resident_memory: Record/vector, fixed session/owner tables and bounded serialization capacities reported separately; wire cap is not resident memory.
